description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter class, verifying logging behavior, MDC handling, and instance management in a Java project using JUnit and Mockito.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter, testing logging and MDC manipulation scenarios.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Verifies no unintended interactions after each test.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullDiagnosticLoggingAdapterFactory
methods.description: Tests that passing null factory throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: withSameCorrelationIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Verifies that calling withCorrelationId with the same value returns the same instance.

methods.name: withCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Tests that info logs with a correlation ID include correct MDC update.

methods.name: doNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no info log is emitted if info level is disabled.

methods.name: withNullCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Verifies behavior when correlation ID is null; log proceeds without MDC update.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntryPairsLogDebugInfoWarningAndError
methods.description: Tests logging at multiple levels with multiple MDC entries.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntriesLogError
methods.description: Verifies error logging with MDC entries and exception.

methods.name: removeCorrelationIdViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests removal of MDC entry when null value is provided.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Tests removal of specific MDC key.
